conditions.C1: Exact named linux/amd64 development images only. No transfer to a rebuild, another architecture, desktop or a public candidate.
conditions.C2: Canonical Compose and entrypoint; nonzero API PUID/PGID; no privileged/capability overrides. Actual API/Nginx processes retain five empty capability sets and no-new-privileges.
conditions.C3: Production-style HTTPS, authentication/authorization, outbound-hostname checks and existing file/preview guards remain enabled; do not expose development servers to untrusted networks.
conditions.C4: Raw snapshots come only from trusted operator-controlled installations with protected provenance and private staging. GNU tar, chown and SQLite processing are not a hostile-input sandbox; checksums do not authenticate origin.
conditions.C5: Keep writable vault access, native memory-corruption/data-loss and denial-of-service residuals explicit. No read-only-root or memory/CPU/PID cap is claimed; daemon containment does not cover separate privileged operator recovery.
conditions.C6: Expiry is the earlier of acceptance plus 30 days or candidate freeze/13D. Reopen immediately for a relevant vendor fix, new caller/input path, changed image/platform, changed advisory, missing evidence or weaker controls. No automatic renewal.
conditions.C7: Approval is local-qualification risk acceptance only, not publication, deployment, a support-policy change, S04/G13-04 closure or Gate 13C/13D acceptance. Hold entries remain unwaived.

previous_deadline.basis: Conservative midnight at start of October 12 in America/New_York; within 30 days of September 12 approval. Earlier candidate freeze/13D or any C6 trigger takes precedence.

owner_boundary.statement: No waiver transfer/renewal, release authority or gate acceptance. Original E/R event remains tied to its original image IDs.
